title: AlphaZero taught itself chess, then crushed Stockfish
body: Given only the rules, DeepMind's AlphaZero played tens of millions of games against itself and within hours outperformed the strongest conventional engine, rediscovering and then discarding human openings. Self-play removed the ceiling of imitating us. The same algorithm took Go, chess and shogi, suggesting the recipe, not the game knowledge, was the discovery.
